============================================================
  RSOB - Quality Performance Dashboard - NA & EU
  Setup Instructions
============================================================

STEP 1: Download
-----------------
Save these 2 files to the SAME folder on your desktop:
  - dashboard.html
  - OPEN-DASHBOARD.bat

Both files MUST be in the same folder.


STEP 2: Open the Dashboard
---------------------------
Double-click "OPEN-DASHBOARD.bat"

A black command window will appear — DO NOT close it.
Your browser will open automatically.


STEP 3: Login
--------------
Enter your login ID (same as your corporate login).
  - Managers: You will see your team's quality data
  - Associates: You will see your own quality data

Click "Sign In".


STEP 4: Using the Dashboard
-----------------------------
- Use the Region filter (NA / EU / All) to switch regions
- Use the Weeks filter to select time period
- Use the Month filter to view monthly data
- Click "Download CSV" on any table to export data
- Click "Raw Data" in the top nav to see transaction details


STEP 5: Close
--------------
When done, close the browser tab.
Then close the black command window (or press Ctrl+C).


TROUBLESHOOTING
----------------
Q: Browser shows blank page?
A: Make sure you opened via OPEN-DASHBOARD.bat, NOT by
   double-clicking dashboard.html directly.

Q: "Port 8080 already in use" error?
A: Close any other command windows running the dashboard,
   then try again.

Q: Can't see any data?
A: Make sure you entered your correct login ID.
   Associates see only their own data.
   Managers see only their team's data.


CONTACT
--------
For issues or questions, contact: mpuranik
